name: Global Mental Health Counseling Center
description:
Global Mental Health Counseling Center is a dedicated and confidential counseling space for women and couples in Nalasopara, Vasai, Virar and nearby areas. We specialize in supporting emotional well-being, healthy relationships and mental strength through professional, compassionate and ethical counselling services.
Women often face emotional pressure related to relationships, marriage, motherhood, career stress, hormonal changes, trauma, anxiety and depression. At our center, we provide a safe, non-judgmental and respectful environment where women can openly express their feelings and receive personalized therapeutic support
We offer specialized counselling for Women’s Mental Health, including Anxiety, Depression, Stress, Emotional support

featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Global Mental Health Counseling Center for education and career counseling, and I received excellent support. As a girl, I was guided and motivated on how to start and manage a business, and the counselors helped me understand my strengths and career goals clearly.
They also supported me in switching my career field, explained different options, and helped me make confident and practical decisions about my future. The counseling sessions were very informative, empowering, and supportive.
I felt encouraged, understood, and confident after the sessions. I highly recommend this center to students and young professionals who are looking for career clarity, business guidance, or a safe and supportive environment for decision-making.

featured_reviews.name: NAASA SCIENCE ACADEMY
featured_reviews.review_text:
My name is Jack Fernandes, and I switched my career from Commerce back to Science. The guidance I received at Global Mental Health Counseling Center was extremely helpful. The plan suggested to me was practical and clearly explained according to my IQ level, abilities, and potential. I was guided step by step on what to do and what is realistically possible for my future.
I had several insecurities and doubts, which I discussed openly with Psychologist Abdullah Shaikh. He listened patiently, understood my concerns, and helped me gain clarity and confidence. The counseling sessions played a major role in helping me overcome fear and confusion regarding my career decisions.
I am very satisfied with the support I received and 100% recommend this center to anyone who needs proper career guidance or is planning a career switch.

featured_reviews.name: Ifra Pathan

My name is Ifrah, age 18, and I visited Global Mental Health Counseling Center for Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD). I was also struggling with panic attacks, and this center helped me a lot in managing and overcoming them.
The counselors are extremely caring, professional, and understanding. They listened to me without judgment and supported me through my healing journey. The therapy sessions helped me understand my triggers, reduce my panic attacks, and slowly recover from my past trauma.
I felt safe, comfortable, and supported throughout the treatment. The guidance I received truly made a positive difference in my mental health and daily life. I am very thankful to the entire team and highly recommend this center to anyone dealing with trauma, panic attacks, or mental health challenges.

How stress can wear you down

*What is the impact of stress? *

Stress affects a person’s physical, mental, and emotional health. When stress continues for a long time, it can cause headaches, tiredness, sleep problems, high blood pressure, and a weak immune system. Mentally, stress reduces concentration, memory, and decision-making ability, and may lead to anxiety or depression. Emotionally, a stressed person may feel irritable, restless, or overwhelmed. Stress can also affect behaviour, causing changes in eating habits, social withdrawal, or poor work performance. Managing stress is important to maintain overall health and well-being.
